sections.text:
[Effects]
Target: yourself. Applies Reliance that nullifies Unison gauge reduction caused by Ability Effects or Unison Effects for 1 time.

[Activation Category]
Other Opening Skill (up to 2 Opening Skills of the same category can be used at once).

[Effect Duration]
For 52 seconds from the start of the battle.
Level Bonus: Extends effect by 2 seconds for each increase in Skill level.
